# Snappy Leads

Snappy Leads sets up website chatbots and optional AI voice agents for service businesses. The founder, Danny Sullivan, handles setup and support.

## Website chat

The chatbot answers questions using approved business information, collects contact details and service requests, and saves conversations in each customer's private dashboard. Customers can review lead sources, mark outcomes, and record the value of booked jobs. Appointment requests need confirmation from the business.

Website chat starts at $399 per month. The 14-day free trial starts after setup and requires no card. Final pricing and included usage are confirmed before payment.

## Voice agents

Voice AI is a separate service starting at $799 per month. It greets callers, gathers their needs and callback details, and provides summaries and transcripts. Call forwarding and transfer rules are configured with the business. Chat and voice together have custom pricing.
